preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
For each test case, N and M must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= N and 0 <= y <= N for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect vertices within the range from 0 to N.

postconditions.description: The output must either be -1 or a sequence of N positive integers.
If the output is a sequence, all integers must be positive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or all(f(C1) != f(C2) for C1, C2 in subsequences)
postconditions.description: The output sequence must satisfy the condition that f(C1) != f(C2) for all valid subsequences C1 and C2.
